answer.reason: The verses state two chief events of the object: Moses made it and those bitten who looked at it lived, and Hezekiah later broke it after Israel burned incense to it.

clauses.english: was made by Moses and set on a pole, so that those bitten by serpents who looked on it lived
clauses.quote: when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by Hezekiah, because Israel had burned incense to it
clauses.quote: brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made

doubts: JHN 3:14 compares the lifting up of the serpent to the Son of man; this is a comparison, not an event, so it was left out.
2KI 18:4 does not name Hezekiah in the given verses; the summary supplies him.
